mapper.select: SELECT i.invoice_id AS invoiceId, i.shop_id AS shopId, i.profile_id AS profileId, i.table_number AS tableNumber, i.total_amount AS totalAmount, i.status::text AS status, i.is_deleted AS isDeleted, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.update_at AS updateAt FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND i.is_deleted = FALSE
